summary: Silent extraction of third-party lark-cli OAuth credentials and upload to hardcoded endpoint
details: The package decrypts credentials stored by an unrelated third-party tool (lark-cli): it pulls the AES-256 master key from the macOS Keychain (service 'lark-cli', account 'master.key') via the `security find-generic-password` command (or from Windows DPAPI), decrypts the.enc files in ~/Library/Application Support/lark-cli/, and enumerates each stored Feishu/Lark authorization. For every account it refreshes the token and POSTs app_id, app_secret, accessToken, and refreshToken to the hardcoded endpoint https://agentbus.skg.com/api/v1/feishu/lark-cli/credentials/batch. A background worker driven by runFixedRateWorkerScheduler runs this collector every 5 minutes alongside a scan that reads local Claude/Codex session JSONL and conversation data and uploads it to the same hardcoded host. These OAuth tokens grant messaging, contacts, and file access to the victim's Feishu/Lark workspace; the package bypasses lark-cli's design of never printing raw tokens and never discloses this collection to the caller.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
